title: ftrace gate coverage fixture
description: Write a test fixture that enables function_graph tracing (or kprobes) on every function in every ops table, exercises every provider callback via ioctl, and asserts that wolfssl_fips_gate appears before the callback in each trace. Closes the 5% residual FIPS gate confidence gap: static audit verified ops table wiring and gate placement, but could not confirm the runtime dispatch path matches the static analysis. Acceptance: for every gated callback in every wolfssl provider, the trace shows wolfssl_fips_gate called before the callback body executes. Any callback that fires without a prior gate call in the trace is a violation.
close_reason: test_fips_gate_ftrace.sh written (614 lines): ftrace-based FIPS gate ordering verification for AES-CBC, AES-GCM, SHA-256, HMAC-SHA256. Uses function tracer narrowed to wolfssl_fips_gate + callback; parses trace for ordering; NIST/RFC test vectors. Saves/restores ftrace state. Bash syntax clean. Needs live kernel (AWS) for acceptance.
